    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    Authentication
    Handles user authentication, sign-up, login, and logout functionality.
    Budget
    Represents a budget category with a specific amount, limit, and date range.
    BudgetManager
    Manages budget-related operations for a user.
    Debt
    Represents a debt with a creditor, total amount, remaining amount, and due date.
    DebtManager
    Manages debts for a user, allowing addition of new debts.
    Expense
    Represents an expense with a specific category, amount, and date.
    ExpenseManager
    Manages expense-related operations for a user.
    Income
    Represents an income source with a specific amount and date.
    IncomeManager
    Manages income-related operations for a user.
    Insights_and_Financial_reports
    Provides insights and generates financial reports for a user.
    MailManager
    Represents a MailManager that sends emails for important notifications (OTP and reminders)
    Main
    Entry point for the Budget App.
    Notification
    Represents a notification that has a specific ID, content and details for Date and Time sent
    NotificationManager
    Responsible for sending notifications
    OTPManager
    Manages the generation, validation, and sending of OTP codes via email.
    Reminder
    Represents a reminder with a title, date, and time.
    ReminderChecker
    Periodically checks if the current date and time match any reminders for the logged-in user.
    ReminderManager
    Manages reminders for a user, including adding new reminders.
    Saving_Goal
    Represents a saving goal with a target amount, deadline, and total savings.
    Saving_GoalManager
    Manages saving goals for a user, allowing addition of new saving goals.
    User
    Represents a user in the budgeting application.
